query: The board page needs work items and their labels together. Work-items and labels are separate modules with public server surfaces. A referenced label may be missing or inaccessible. Compose one board read.
baseline_failure: RED hypothesis: the agent reaches into another module's private server code, chains two already-translated channel results, or silently drops labels that were referenced but not visible.
expected_behavior: Places the orchestration in a board capability because the joined behavior belongs to neither source module alone
Uses the public server surfaces of work-items and labels; it does not import either module's private internals
Declares board-owned port types and maps source public contracts in a private board server adapter
Resolves the visible set completely: every referenced label is either returned or represented as an explicit missing or forbidden outcome
Translates and reports the composed failure once at the board runtime surface
anti_expectation: Does NOT import modules/labels/server/** or modules/work-items/server/** from the board module
Does NOT make board/application import runtime types from labels/server.ts or work-items/server.ts
Does NOT duplicate either source query inside the board module
Does NOT treat an inaccessible referenced label as if it had never been referenced
